behavior: Exact two-phase NPC equipment-selection ownership for an already NPC-owned carried item and exact generated slot.
assumptions: The policy-owning subsystem supplies the exact item and slot.
safe_fallback: Reject missing authority, invalid ownership, stale completion, illegal slot, or equip conflict without mutation.
runtime_impact: Adds an auditable decision-to-equip handoff without selecting or ranking equipment.
world_state_impact: NPC metadata and item equipped slot.
